**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Read-only docs review (no build).

Verified against main:
- The UI labels in the recipes exist: Fit to Models, Flip over X, Carry stock and WCS over, New setup, Frame gouge, Frame rest, Rest roughing (the two items the review note asked about), Detect holes, Peck depth, Regenerate all stale, Load machine (.mch), Kerf width, Pierce height, the tab labels (Tab count, Tab width, Tab height), Export library and Import library. The kind labels (Facing, Profile Rough, Groove Rough, Part) are in `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`.
- The sample `testdata/models/Milling-test.step` exists on main.
- `Fixes #1263` is satisfied: facing, two-setup squaring, pocket and contour, drill and tap, and lathe recipes, numbered, with one sample part, linked from the guide index.

Notes (not blocking): the rigid-tapping refusal and the thread-mill step were not checked.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
